sources.snippet: Overview pixai-tagger-v0.9-onnx is an ONNX-exported version of PixAI's multilabel image classification model for tagging anime and illustration artwork. Built and maintained by deepghs, this 317.9M parameter model classifies images across 13,461 distinct tags spanning general features, character identities, and copyright information. sources.snippet: PixAI Tagger ONNX GUI utilizes the ONNX version of the image tagging model developed by PixAI to assign tags to local images. The original PixAI Tagger supports over 13,000 rich tags, offering an advantage compared to common tagging models (e.g., wd-tagger's ~10,000 tags).
